'''Desevro''' was a [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|heavily urbanized]], ancient [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]].

==History==
Before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was formed, Desevro was the capital of the [[Livien League]] before being conquered by [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot c. [[25,130 BBY]], and became one of his four capital worlds, along with [[Argai]], [[Cadinth]], and [[Chandaar]]; it was named as the Fourth Throne of Xim. In [[25,100 BBY]], Xim ordered a secret vault built on the Swampland estate of his Desevrar [[Chamberlain/Legends|chamberlain]].<ref name="Xim Week" /> It also housed the gigantic [[Statue of Xim]], one of the "[[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]]", until a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] destroyed it not long before Xim's death.<ref name="TEA" />

Desevro was a bureaucratic and administrative capital of [[Xim's empire]]; Desevrar bureaucracts maintained the matters around the Empire, and the Livien alphabet was adopted as the official script for the [[Old Tionese]] language.<ref>{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/writtenword/index.html?page=1|text=The Written Word|int=The Written Word}}</ref>

After Xim's death later in 25,100 BBY, the planet became capital of the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion]], an oligarchy ruled by the [[Thirty-seven Families]], the nobles of Desevro. The Union maintained an intense rivalry with the [[Kingdom of Cron]].

In [[24,000 BBY]], [[Tionese War|the Union made war]] with the young [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. This proved its undoing. The Republic dropped volleys of [[pressure bomb]]s on Desevro, and the Desevrars gave [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] the same treatment. After nearly a century of fighting, the Republic won the war by turning the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] against the Union, allowing them to invade the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. This led to the Union's end as an independent state, and with its situation desperate, Desevro offered its unconditional surrender to the Republic. It was refused: the Republic opted to sterilize Desevro as an object lesson to the rest of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]].

The worlds of the Union joined the Republic by [[23,900 BBY]]. As a result, the planet became a political backwater even for the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], and its cities fell into a precipitous decay. Desevrars, as the native Tionese were called, were extremely [[Speciesism|speciesist]], calling all non-[[Human/Legends|humans]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]].

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] placed [[Reaver Station]] over Desevro, which they took control of as a port for entertainment to be used for leave.

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Desevro was aligned with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Desevro has 400.000.000.000 inhabitants
